filter: TRAIN robot episodes only, independent strict_current_settle_success=true
validation_selection: minimum respective frozen validation objective on original full validation split (GRU normalized action loss; diffusion epsilon MSE); failed validation episodes retained
additional_reporting: successful validation teacher subset may be reported, never used to select checkpoints
hyperparameters: identical to primary respective GRU or diffusion protocol
expert: same recovery-only full85s frozen teacher source
failure_retention: original full manifest/raw failures retained; curated manifest lists every excluded train episode and hash
final_evaluation: same frozen five conditions, preserve both primary and ablation; no winner selected from final outcomes
normalization: same approved prefit feature-contract units as primary
